task_type: supplier API card enrichment and production release
requested_outcome: Preserve the optional Biz preview_text field from vacation list and detail responses and show it as a compact additive caption beneath the matching place card without changing existing card content or layout when the field is absent.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co vacation discovery cards, with שקד באופק as the production proof case
authorization_boundary: Code, tests, catalog mapping and public publication are authorized. No supplier data mutation, real lead, booking, message, destructive data action or unrelated redesign is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The change consumes a new VII supplier contract field and affects public vacation cards.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use the VII master plan and feedback standard, preserve supplier truth, and verify the whole vacation-card family.

lesson_bundle.reason: Adir explicitly requires this to be additive and not damage the approved card design.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Freeze every existing card element and reject any replacement, overlap, empty reserved gap or broken action.

lesson_bundle.reason: Vacation cards appear in several discovery surfaces and responsive widths.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify a shared implementation on desktop, mobile and representative card surfaces.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested outcome is a public visible release.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact deployed-version evidence plus inspected desktop and mobile proof.

predicted_rejections.rejection: preview_text appears only on one route because another card path drops the field.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Carry the field through both list and detail normalization and the shared public catalog summary.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: List and detail fixtures retain the field and all PropertyCard consumers receive the same optional property.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Cards without preview_text gain an empty strip or changed height.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Render only a trimmed non-empty value and apply no placeholder or minimum height.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A paired card without the field has no caption node and no reserved caption spacing.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The new sentence covers the photo, controls or existing details instead of being an additive caption below the card square.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Place a dedicated non-interactive row after the existing card body and before no existing content; preserve all current hierarchy and actions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and mobile screenshots show the caption beneath existing card content with no overlap and all controls intact.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The code passes locally but שקד באופק still lacks the phrase in production.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Refresh the accepted catalog generation after release and verify the exact public card and source field.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The public exact release visibly shows מקום עם לב ונשמה for שקד באופק and a control card without a phrase remains unchanged.

affected_family: accepted and bundled vacation catalog summary projections
shared PropertyCard on search, home, regional, holiday and last-minute discovery surfaces
cards with a phrase, without a phrase, and with a long two-line phrase

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the official field is retained by one list fixture, one detail fixture and one representative PropertyCard render, before full regression and publication.
checks: A non-empty preview_text survives list and detail normalization unchanged as plain trimmed text.
The representative card renders the sentence once below the existing card content.
The same card without preview_text has no caption element and no empty space.

attack_questions: Can the supplier field be lost during a partial refresh that reuses old detail data?
Can HTML, whitespace or a very long supplier sentence break the card?
Can any existing click, favorite, gallery, contact or price control be covered or moved into the wrong layer?
Can a card without the field still reserve space?
Can the exact public Shaked BaOfek card fail to show the text even though local fixtures pass?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public release opened on desktop and mobile, showing שקד באופק with מקום עם לב ונשמה and a control card without a caption gap.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated normalization and render tests plus representative public search/home/region card inspection.

effectiveness.baseline: The new official API field is documented but absent from the current VII data model and public cards.
effectiveness.target: One additive implementation is visible on the exact public supplier card with zero regression in existing card layout or actions.
